:   Parameters
:   * **api\_key** (`str`) â An Airtable API key or personal access token.
* **timeout** (`Optional`[`Tuple`[`int`, `int`]], default: `None`) â A tuple indicating a connect and read timeout. e.g. `timeout=(2,5)` would configure a 2 second timeout for the connection to be established and 5 seconds for a server read timeout. Default is `None` (no timeout).
* **retry\_strategy** (`Union`[`bool`, `Retry`, `None`], default: `True`) â An instance of [urllib3.util.Retry](https://urllib3.readthedocs.io/en/stable/reference/urllib3.util.html#urllib3.util.Retry). If `None` or `False`, requests will not be retried. If `True`, the default strategy will be applied (see [`retry_strategy()`](#pyairtable.retry_strategy "pyairtable.retry_strategy") for details).
* **endpoint\_url** (`str`, default: `'https://api.airtable.com'`) â The API endpoint to use. Override this if you are using a debugging or caching proxy.
* **use\_field\_ids** (`bool`, default: `False`) â If `True`, all API requests will return responses with field IDs instead of field names.
